resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 6,915 ft (2,108 m); firelookout.com gives 6,921 ft. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only substantive source; firelookout.com and the Montana Forest Lookouts page repeat its agency and build year, and the firelookout.com page confirms the 29-mile location. The Montana record has no staffing, fire or access detail, so those are left out of facts. A search result for a Rogers Mountain in Stevens County, Washington (willhiteweb.com, a different lookout with a 1934 pole tower) was excluded and must not be merged with this record. Photo credit noted on firelookout.com (Rod Fisher) but no image URL was captured, so no photos added. Not verified: whether DNRC allows public visits or rentals, and the current condition of the cab.
